messages:
Hannah Lee: Noticed a weird pattern on USW2-aisle9: multiple tenants showing transient OOMs while overall GPU mem usage stays <90%. Looks like ballooning from a new background prefetcher + PCIe thrash causing slab fragmentation.

Omar Farooq: saw that too. Telemetry shows interleaved memcpy bursts and high PCIe retransmit counters correlated with tenant tid-7201 and tid-2044.

Hannah Lee: tenant tid-7201 is running a wide warmup that allocates then frees lots of KV pages, causing slab churn and cross-tenant eviction storms.

InfraBot: ALERT aisle9-shelf6: pcie_retries +48%, slab_evictions +310%, gpu_mem_fragmentation 0.27. Incident INC-11077 created.

Yuri Petrov: short mitigation: enable per-tenant slab_quota and prefetch_jitter. We can patch allocator for those tenants quickly.

Claire Holt: agree. Proposed steps: 1) set slab_quota_mb to 1024 for tid-7201, 2) enable prefetch_jitter_ms=200-1200, 3) apply soft-route to move new fractional allocations off aisle9 for 15m.

Omar Farooq: command to run now:
```
allocatorctl set-tenant --tenant=tid-7201 --slab_quota_mb=1024 --prefetch_jitter_ms=600
allocatorctl set-routing --avoid=aisle9 --duration=15m --scope=fractional
```
This should reduce immediate churn and spread new warmups.

InfraBot: ACTION executed: tenant slab quota set; routing avoidance applied. Live stream: https://telemetry.redwood/aisle9/INC-11077

(45s) InfraBot: metrics: pcie_retries down 30%, slab_evictions down 45%, gpu_mem_fragmentation trending to 0.18.

Hannah Lee: good improvement. Two follow-ups: 1) consider a scheduler change to prefer cross-rack placement for prefetch-heavy tenants when PCIe retry rate > threshold, 2) add billing flag for repeat offenders that consumes disproportionate page churn.

Yuri Petrov: for 1) we can implement a quick heuristic: if pcie_retries > 30% and slab_evictions > 200% for 5m, set alloc_preference to cross_rack and require target_rack_headroom>1GB. For 2) Ops: create cost-review tag on tid-7201.

Claire Holt: also document guidance for customers: "Avoid wide ephemeral allocations that allocate+drop many KV pages within short windows; prefer streaming hints or dedicated slices for >1GB ephemeral working set."

Omar Farooq: cost tradeoff note: cross-rack placement increases egress and potential latency; we should surface expected unit-cost delta to customers when offering auto-divert or dedicated carveouts.

Hannah Lee: agreed. I'll open OPS ticket to add automation and a short customer advisory. Tagging product for a billing UX to display estimated cost delta during migration offer.

InfraBot: NOTE automation task created: AUTO-2310. Closing thread after 30m stable. :white_check_mark:
